sites.ownership: The compare controller owns the tab-local rendered presentation rows and custom line-number gutter model.
sites.justification: Read-only compare panes render from ephemeral presentation buffers, so custom gutters, hatch layers, and tests need one shared source of display-row to original-line mapping.

sites.ownership: The compare controller owns the tab-local logical diff row model.
sites.justification: Presentation rendering, hunk navigation, status, and test accessors must share one ephemeral row model so manual Compare and Git compare cannot drift into parallel diff states.

sites.ownership: The compare diff unit tests own one thread-local line-diff call counter.
sites.justification: The Finding 5.1 regression test must prove each non-large compare path uses one full line diff while avoiding cross-test interference under parallel cargo test execution.

sites.ownership: Compare gutter state owns a shared handle to the tab-local presentation line-number model.
sites.justification: Refreshing both gutters after compare recompute, zoom, and style changes needs the latest row map without copying per-pane line-number state.

sites.ownership: Compare gutter state owns a shared handle to the tab-local logical row model.
sites.justification: Custom gutter marker cells need the current row kind so equal rows reserve a blank marker column while reference/current changes render visual -/+ markers after recompute.

sites.ownership: Compare gutter setup borrows the controller-owned presentation line-number model.
sites.justification: Both gutter renderers need read-only access to the same presentation row map so placeholder rows stay blank without copying per-pane line-number state.

sites.ownership: Compare gutter setup borrows the controller-owned logical row model.
sites.justification: GtkSourceView queries gutter marker text per visible line, so the renderer callback must read the latest row kind after every recompute and keep visual +/- markers aligned with the active row model.

sites.ownership: Compare scroll synchronization owns a shared handle to the tab-local logical row model.
sites.justification: Programmatic first-hunk and hunk-navigation scrolls verify the target presentation row against the current row count without copying diff state into the scroll helper.

sites.ownership: Compare scroll synchronization owns the left pane signal handler id.
sites.justification: Peer scroll updates block the opposite value-changed handler while preserving row and intra-row offset, so the handler id must be available to both the installer and the RAII block guard.

sites.ownership: Compare scroll synchronization owns the right pane signal handler id.
sites.justification: Peer scroll updates block the opposite value-changed handler while preserving row and intra-row offset, so the handler id must be available to both the installer and the RAII block guard.

sites.ownership: Compare scroll regression tests own a left-pane callback counter.
sites.justification: The test-only counter verifies smooth-scroll bursts do not bounce through the peer handler after programmatic sync blocks recursive value-changed emissions.

sites.ownership: Compare scroll regression tests own a right-pane callback counter.
sites.justification: The test-only counter verifies smooth-scroll bursts do not bounce through the peer handler after programmatic sync blocks recursive value-changed emissions.

sites.ownership: Compare row scroll synchronization borrows the controller-owned logical row model.
sites.justification: Live split-diff scrolling follows the top visible presentation row plus intra-row offset, so value-change callbacks need the current row count from the shared row model.

sites.ownership: Compare row scroll synchronization reads the controller-owned logical row model during sync.
sites.justification: The sync helper clamps top-visible-row lookup to the latest row count while preserving source intra-row offset without copying model state into adjustment callbacks.

sites.ownership: Compare row scroll synchronization borrows the target pane signal handler id.
sites.justification: Programmatic peer adjustment writes block the target handler with an RAII guard so row+offset sync cannot recurse during touchpad smooth-scroll bursts.

sites.ownership: The scoped signal block borrows one compare pane signal handler id.
sites.justification: The RAII guard blocks and unblocks the peer value-changed handler around a direct adjustment write, avoiding recursive sync without leaving handlers muted on early returns.

sites.ownership: Compare hatch GTK test accessors own a shared handle to the tab-local presentation model.
sites.justification: Regression tests inspect visible hatch regions against the latest placeholder row map without copying per-pane presentation state; this field is test-only.

sites.ownership: Each compare hatch layer owns the cached high-contrast state shared with its draw callback.
sites.justification: Style changes update the cached value once, while the DrawingArea callback can render the high-contrast solid fallback without querying libadwaita on every frame.

sites.ownership: Each compare hatch layer owns an idempotent detach guard.
sites.justification: Compare exit and Drop can both reach overlay cleanup, so the Cell prevents duplicate widget unparenting without introducing a wider controller-level mutable borrow.

sites.ownership: Compare hatch setup borrows the controller-owned presentation row map.
sites.justification: Both pane hatch layers share the same presentation model so ReferenceOnly and CurrentOnly placeholder classification stays aligned with the rendered buffers.

sites.ownership: A compare hatch layer borrows the controller-owned presentation row map during setup.
sites.justification: The DrawingArea callback receives a shared handle to the latest presentation rows so hatch rendering follows recompute and does not duplicate diff state.

sites.ownership: The compare hatch draw callback borrows the shared presentation row map.
sites.justification: Drawing only visible placeholder rows requires the latest presentation-side classification while keeping the renderer tied to the controller-owned compare state.

sites.ownership: The compare hatch draw callback borrows the shared high-contrast flag.
sites.justification: The callback must see style refreshes without per-frame StyleManager queries, and the Cell keeps the cached render mode local to the hatch layer.

sites.justification: The flat ListView factory is created before controller Rc wiring and must dispatch row actions against the current snapshot without retaining the window.

sites.justification: Git metadata monitor and polling callbacks need coalesced refresh timing and index-lock deferral without blocking the main loop.

sites.ownership: The Source Control view switcher owns its programmatic-toggle guard.
sites.justification: Tree/list mode synchronization must update buttons and stack visibility without recursively writing GSettings.

sites.ownership: The Source Control view switcher owns its last rendered snapshot.
sites.justification: Tree/list no-op refreshes compare against the last prepared entries so automatic Git polling does not rebuild rows or reset selection.

sites.ownership: The Source Control view switcher owns its programmatic-toggle guard.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns the last successfully loaded HEAD.
sites.justification: Recent commits are refetched only when HEAD changes or a previous history read failed, preventing index-only refresh flicker.

sites.ownership: The Source Control history widget owns its transient retry flag.
sites.justification: A failed recent-commits read must self-heal on the next successful status refresh without refetching on every index-only update.

sites.ownership: The project sidebar owns a shared programmatic-position guard.
sites.justification: Animated GtkPaned position updates must bypass drag clamping in both directions while user drag input can still cancel the animation.

sites.ownership: The Source Control live-refresh scheduler owns timeout cancellation state.
sites.justification: GLib timeout one-shots have no Gio cancellable, so stale scheduler clones share a small cancellation flag before probing Git metadata or refreshing UI.

sites.ownership: The Source Control live-refresh tests own counters for scheduler probe and refresh callbacks.
sites.justification: The test-only counters prove cancelled and polling schedulers return before sync lock probes without sharing state outside the unit test.
